title: Discover Android BIN/CUE data in the documented app folder
problem: Android directs players to /sdcard/lba2cc, but that probe only accepts extracted HQR files, so a supported BIN/CUE-only rip is rejected on first launch.
reproduce: At the pinned baseline, inspect both app-specific shared-storage probes: neither passes allowImage=true to TryJoinBaseSub, although an explicitly selected directory containing the same image is accepted.
acceptance: Both lba2cc probes use image-aware validation, the broad /sdcard probes remain extracted-file-only to avoid expensive directory walks, and the documented behavior matches the implementation.
repair: Enable the existing image-aware validator for /sdcard/lba2cc and /storage/emulated/0/lba2cc and document the deliberate scope of the scan.

verification.limitations: BCL proves the two exact discovery-policy calls and their documented performance boundary at the pinned source revision. Host discovery and 71 host-quick tests passed outside the portable case. A real Android arm64 first launch with the reporter's BIN/CUE rip remains owner-validated.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the PR build on the same Android arm64 target, place only the BIN/CUE rip in /sdcard/lba2cc without last_game_dir.txt, launch, and report the Assets and Disc boot-log lines.
